# Buttondown Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that reads and writes your Buttondown newsletter: list subscribers, list emails (drafts and sent), add subscribers, and create email drafts. `email-create` always drafts first — `--send` emails the whole list and requires your confirmation of subject, audience, and body. Reading needs no confirmation. Buttondown has a free plan. Draft: written from Buttondown's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
